roadmap and tooling text. Follow the active `work/WO-*.md`; inspect its allowed
and protected paths before editing. Keep each work order buildable, tested,

- `src/`: base, platform, XML/SVG, scene, raster, document, UI modules as added.

//! Checked byte spans and a bounded, resettable arena for the owned Rust port.
//!
//! Arena storage is owned by aligned blocks. Handles are offsets into chunks,
//! never pointers, so moving an arena does not invalidate them and Rust borrows
//! prevent access while the arena is being changed.

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};

#[cfg(not(all(target_os = "macos", target_arch = "aarch64")))]
compile_error!("Vexel initially supports Apple Silicon macOS 13+ only");

/// Error outcomes corresponding to the non-success C `base_status` values.
/// Success is represented by `Ok(…)` in Rust.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum BaseStatus {
    Invalid,
    Overflow,
    Limit,
    OutOfMemory,
}

/// A checked half-open range into source bytes.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Span {
    pub start: usize,
    pub end: usize,
}

impl Span {
    /// Create a span from an offset and length, returning `None` on overflow.
    pub fn from_offset_length(offset: usize, length: usize) -> Option<Self> {
        Some(Self {
            start: offset,
            end: offset.checked_add(length)?,
        })
    }

    /// Borrow this span from `source` if both endpoints are in bounds.
    pub fn slice(self, source: &[u8]) -> Option<&[u8]> {
        source.get(self.start..self.end)
    }
}

/// Return `a + b`, or `None` if the result cannot fit in `usize`.
pub fn size_add(a: usize, b: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    a.checked_add(b)
}

/// Return `a * b`, or `None` if the result cannot fit in `usize`.
pub fn size_mul(a: usize, b: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    a.checked_mul(b)
}

/// Borrowed immutable byte slice; empty slices may naturally have no address.
pub type Bytes<'a> = &'a [u8];
/// Borrowed mutable byte slice.
pub type MutBytes<'a> = &'a mut [u8];

/// Take a checked subrange. Empty ranges are valid, including at the end.
pub fn bytes_sub(bytes: Bytes<'_>, offset: usize, length: usize) -> Option<Bytes<'_>> {
    let end = offset.checked_add(length)?;
    bytes.get(offset..end)
}

/// Take a checked mutable subrange. Empty ranges are valid, including at the end.
pub fn mut_bytes_sub(
    bytes: MutBytes<'_>,
    offset: usize,
    length: usize,
) -> Option<MutBytes<'_>> {
    let end = offset.checked_add(length)?;
    bytes.get_mut(offset..end)
}

/// Compare byte slices, with length mismatch handled before content comparison.
pub fn bytes_equal(left: Bytes<'_>, right: Bytes<'_>) -> bool {
    left == right
}

/// Ask permission for each backing allocation before attempting it.
///
/// This seam supports deterministic failure injection and bounded allocators.
/// It does not allocate memory itself; the arena separately uses Rust's
/// fallible `try_reserve_exact` API. Return `OutOfMemory` to reject an attempt.
pub trait AllocationGate {
    fn permit(&mut self, requested_bytes: usize) -> Result<(), BaseStatus>;
}

#[derive(Default)]
#[doc(hidden)]
pub struct SystemAllocationGate;

impl AllocationGate for SystemAllocationGate {
    fn permit(&mut self, _requested_bytes: usize) -> Result<(), BaseStatus> {
        Ok(())
    }
}

const MAX_ALIGNMENT: usize = 4096;
static NEXT_ARENA_ID: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(1);

// Each element begins on a 4096-byte boundary, sufficient for every supported
// arena alignment. Vec's element layout carries this alignment contract.
#[repr(align(4096))]
struct AlignedBlock([u8; MAX_ALIGNMENT]);

struct Chunk {
    blocks: Vec<AlignedBlock>,
    capacity: usize,
    used: usize,
}

impl Chunk {
    fn try_new(capacity: usize, gate: &mut dyn AllocationGate) -> Result<Self, BaseStatus> {
        let block_count = capacity
            .checked_add(MAX_ALIGNMENT - 1)
            .ok_or(BaseStatus::Overflow)?
            / MAX_ALIGNMENT;
        let allocation_bytes = block_count
            .checked_mul(std::mem::size_of::<AlignedBlock>())
            .ok_or(BaseStatus::Overflow)?;
        gate.permit(allocation_bytes)?;
        let mut blocks = Vec::new();
        blocks
            .try_reserve_exact(block_count)
            .map_err(|_| BaseStatus::OutOfMemory)?;
        blocks.resize_with(block_count, || AlignedBlock([0; MAX_ALIGNMENT]));
        Ok(Self {
            blocks,
            capacity,
            used: 0,
        })
    }

}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ArenaHandle {
    arena_id: u64,
    chunk: usize,
    offset: usize,
    length: usize,
}

impl ArenaHandle {
    /// Length requested for this allocation.
    pub fn len(self) -> usize {
        self.length
    }

    /// Whether this handle describes an empty allocation.
    pub fn is_empty(self) -> bool {
        self.length == 0
    }
}

/// A borrowed, possibly segmented view of one arena allocation.
///
/// Segments arise because safe standard-library storage uses 4096-aligned
/// blocks; no pointer reinterpretation is needed to expose initialized bytes.
pub struct ArenaSlice<'a> {
    blocks: &'a [AlignedBlock],
    offset: usize,
    length: usize,
}

impl ArenaSlice<'_> {
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize { self.length }
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool { self.length == 0 }
    pub fn get(&self, index: usize) -> Option<u8> {
        if index >= self.length { return None; }
        let absolute = self.offset.checked_add(index)?;
        self.blocks.get(absolute / MAX_ALIGNMENT)?.0.get(absolute % MAX_ALIGNMENT).copied()
    }
    pub fn copy_to(&self, destination: &mut [u8]) -> Option<()> {
        if destination.len() != self.length { return None; }
        for (index, byte) in destination.iter_mut().enumerate() { *byte = self.get(index)?; }
        Some(())
    }
}

/// A mutable borrowed, possibly segmented view of one arena allocation.
pub struct ArenaSliceMut<'a> {
    blocks: &'a mut [AlignedBlock],
    offset: usize,
    length: usize,
}

impl ArenaSliceMut<'_> {
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize { self.length }
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool { self.length == 0 }
    pub fn get(&self, index: usize) -> Option<u8> {
        if index >= self.length { return None; }
        let absolute = self.offset.checked_add(index)?;
        self.blocks.get(absolute / MAX_ALIGNMENT)?.0.get(absolute % MAX_ALIGNMENT).copied()
    }
    pub fn set(&mut self, index: usize, value: u8) -> Option<()> {
        if index >= self.length { return None; }
        let absolute = self.offset.checked_add(index)?;
        *self.blocks.get_mut(absolute / MAX_ALIGNMENT)?.0.get_mut(absolute % MAX_ALIGNMENT)? = value;
        Some(())
    }
    pub fn copy_from(&mut self, source: &[u8]) -> Option<()> {
        if source.len() != self.length { return None; }
        for (index, value) in source.iter().copied().enumerate() { self.set(index, value)?; }
        Some(())
    }
}

/// Observable arena accounting, measured in payload bytes.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ArenaStats {
    pub chunk_count: usize,
    pub payload_capacity: usize,
    pub used_bytes: usize,
}

/// Configuration for bounded arena payload storage.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ArenaConfig {
    pub initial_chunk_bytes: usize,
    pub capacity_limit: usize,
}

/// Reusable bounded storage with stable handles, alignment, and reset behavior.
pub struct Arena<G = SystemAllocationGate> {
    id: u64,
    gate: G,
    chunks: Vec<Chunk>,
    initial_chunk_bytes: usize,
    capacity_limit: usize,
    payload_capacity: usize,
}

impl Arena<SystemAllocationGate> {
    /// Create an arena using fallible standard-library allocations.
    pub fn new(config: ArenaConfig) -> Result<Self, BaseStatus> {
        Self::with_allocation_gate(config, SystemAllocationGate)
    }
}

impl<G: AllocationGate> Arena<G> {
    /// Create an arena with a caller-provided allocation permission seam.
    pub fn with_allocation_gate(config: ArenaConfig, gate: G) -> Result<Self, BaseStatus> {
        if config.initial_chunk_bytes == 0 {
            return Err(BaseStatus::Invalid);
        }
        if config.initial_chunk_bytes > config.capacity_limit {
            return Err(BaseStatus::Limit);
        }
        let id = NEXT_ARENA_ID
            .try_update(Ordering::Relaxed, Ordering::Relaxed, |current| current.checked_add(1))
            .map_err(|_| BaseStatus::Overflow)?;
        Ok(Self {
            id,
            gate,
            chunks: Vec::new(),
            initial_chunk_bytes: config.initial_chunk_bytes,
            capacity_limit: config.capacity_limit,
            payload_capacity: 0,
        })
    }

    /// Reserve `size` bytes with power-of-two alignment up to 4096.
    ///
    /// A zero-sized request succeeds with `None`, matching the C null output.
    /// Any failure leaves arena accounting and existing handles unchanged.
    pub fn push(
        &mut self,
        size: usize,
        alignment: usize,
    ) -> Result<Option<ArenaHandle>, BaseStatus> {
        if alignment == 0 || alignment > MAX_ALIGNMENT || !alignment.is_power_of_two() {
            return Err(BaseStatus::Invalid);
        }
        if size == 0 {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        for (index, chunk) in self.chunks.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            if let Some(offset) = fitting_offset(chunk.used, chunk.capacity, size, alignment) {
                let end = offset.checked_add(size).ok_or(BaseStatus::Overflow)?;
                chunk.used = end;
                return Ok(Some(ArenaHandle {
                    arena_id: self.id,
                    chunk: index,
                    offset,
                    length: size,
                }));
            }
        }
        self.append_chunk(size, alignment).map(Some)
    }

    fn append_chunk(&mut self, size: usize, alignment: usize) -> Result<ArenaHandle, BaseStatus> {
        let remaining = self
            .capacity_limit
            .checked_sub(self.payload_capacity)
            .ok_or(BaseStatus::Overflow)?;
        if size > remaining {
            return Err(BaseStatus::Limit);
        }
        let capacity = self.initial_chunk_bytes.min(remaining).max(size);
        let mut chunk = Chunk::try_new(capacity, &mut self.gate)?;
        let offset = fitting_offset(0, chunk.capacity, size, alignment).ok_or(BaseStatus::Overflow)?;
        let end = offset.checked_add(size).ok_or(BaseStatus::Overflow)?;
        chunk.used = end;
        let new_capacity = self
            .payload_capacity
            .checked_add(capacity)
            .ok_or(BaseStatus::Overflow)?;
        self.chunks
            .try_reserve(1)
            .map_err(|_| BaseStatus::OutOfMemory)?;
        let index = self.chunks.len();
        self.chunks.push(chunk);
        self.payload_capacity = new_capacity;
        Ok(ArenaHandle {
            arena_id: self.id,
            chunk: index,
            offset,
            length: size,
        })
    }

    /// Return a borrowed view of a live handle, or `None` if it is invalid.
    pub fn get(&self, handle: ArenaHandle) -> Option<ArenaSlice<'_>> {
        if handle.arena_id != self.id { return None; }
        let chunk = self.chunks.get(handle.chunk)?;
        let end = handle.offset.checked_add(handle.length)?;
        if end > chunk.capacity { return None; }
        Some(ArenaSlice { blocks: &chunk.blocks, offset: handle.offset, length: handle.length })
    }

    /// Return a mutable borrowed view of a live handle, or `None` if invalid.
    pub fn get_mut(&mut self, handle: ArenaHandle) -> Option<ArenaSliceMut<'_>> {
        if handle.arena_id != self.id { return None; }
        let chunk = self.chunks.get_mut(handle.chunk)?;
        let end = handle.offset.checked_add(handle.length)?;
        if end > chunk.capacity { return None; }
        Some(ArenaSliceMut { blocks: &mut chunk.blocks, offset: handle.offset, length: handle.length })
    }

    /// Check an allocation's alignment. Every chunk base is 4096-byte aligned.
    pub fn handle_is_aligned(&self, handle: ArenaHandle, alignment: usize) -> bool {
        alignment != 0
            && alignment <= MAX_ALIGNMENT
            && alignment.is_power_of_two()
            && self.get(handle).is_some()
            && handle.offset % alignment == 0
    }

    /// Snapshot current payload usage and capacity.
    pub fn stats(&self) -> ArenaStats {
        ArenaStats {
            chunk_count: self.chunks.len(),
            payload_capacity: self.payload_capacity,
            used_bytes: self.chunks.iter().map(|chunk| chunk.used).sum(),
        }
    }

    /// Clear all usage while retaining every allocated chunk for reuse.
    pub fn reset(&mut self) {
        for chunk in &mut self.chunks {
            chunk.used = 0;
        }
    }
}

fn fitting_offset(used: usize, capacity: usize, size: usize, alignment: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    let remainder = used % alignment;
    let padding = if remainder == 0 { 0 } else { alignment - remainder };
    let offset = used.checked_add(padding)?;
    let end = offset.checked_add(size)?;
    (end <= capacity).then_some(offset)
}

/// Largest request accepted by [`fill_random`].
pub const MAX_RANDOM_BYTES: usize = 256;

/// Failure reported by a native system service.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SystemError {
    /// The requested random buffer exceeds the wrapper's fixed bound.
    RandomRequestTooLarge { requested: usize, maximum: usize },
    /// `SecRandomCopyBytes` returned a nonzero `OSStatus`.
    RandomStatus(i32),
    /// `getpeereid` failed; this is the `errno` value captured immediately.
    PeerCredentialsErrno(i32),
}

impl fmt::Display for SystemError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::RandomRequestTooLarge { requested, maximum } => {
                write!(f, "random request of {requested} bytes exceeds {maximum}")
            }
            Self::RandomStatus(status) => {
                write!(f, "SecRandomCopyBytes failed with OSStatus {status}")
            }
            Self::PeerCredentialsErrno(errno) => {
                write!(f, "getpeereid failed with errno {errno}")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for SystemError {}

/// Fill `output` with bytes from Apple's default cryptographic random source.
///
/// Empty output succeeds without calling the native function. Requests above
/// [`MAX_RANDOM_BYTES`] are rejected before any native call. If the native
/// call fails, every byte in `output` is cleared before its status is returned.
pub fn fill_random(output: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
    if output.len() > MAX_RANDOM_BYTES {
        return Err(SystemError::RandomRequestTooLarge {
            requested: output.len(),
            maximum: MAX_RANDOM_BYTES,
        });
    }
    if output.is_empty() {
        return Ok(());
    }

    let status = sys::fill_random(output);
    random_result(status, output)
}

fn random_result(status: i32, output: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
    if status == 0 {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        output.fill(0);
        Err(SystemError::RandomStatus(status))
    }
}

/// Return the real user ID of the calling process, as reported by `getuid`.
pub fn current_uid() -> u32 {
    sys::current_uid()
}

/// Return the user and group IDs associated with a connected peer socket.
///
/// The descriptor is borrowed only for the duration of this call. Credentials
/// are returned as Darwin's 32-bit `uid_t` and `gid_t` values.
pub fn peer_credentials(socket: BorrowedFd<'_>) -> Result<(u32, u32), SystemError> {
    sys::peer_credentials(socket).map_err(SystemError::PeerCredentialsErrno)
}

//! Strict native Vexel project bundle v1 codec.

mod bundle;

pub use bundle::{
    Asset, BundleFailure, BundleInput, BundleView, Error, Result, ASSET_HEADER_BYTES,
    HEADER_BYTES, MAGIC, MAX_ASSET_BYTES, MAX_ASSET_COUNT, MAX_ASSET_NAME_BYTES,
    MAX_ASSET_TOTAL_BYTES, MAX_BYTES, MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES, MAX_MEDIA_TYPE_BYTES,
    MAX_SCENE_BYTES, MAX_TIMELINE_BYTES, VERSION, decode, encode, encode_into,
    encoded_size, has_magic,
};
use std::collections::TryReserveError;

pub const VERSION: u32 = 1;
pub const HEADER_BYTES: usize = 56;
pub const MAX_BYTES: usize = 1_073_741_824;
pub const MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES: usize = 1_048_576;
pub const MAX_SCENE_BYTES: usize = 268_435_456;
pub const MAX_TIMELINE_BYTES: usize = 67_108_864;
pub const MAX_ASSET_COUNT: usize = 1024;
pub const MAX_ASSET_NAME_BYTES: usize = 128;
pub const MAX_MEDIA_TYPE_BYTES: usize = 128;
pub const MAX_ASSET_BYTES: usize = 268_435_456;
pub const MAX_ASSET_TOTAL_BYTES: usize = 536_870_912;
pub const ASSET_HEADER_BYTES: usize = 16;
pub const MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b"VEXEL\r\n\x1a";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u32)]
pub enum Error {
    Ok,
    InvalidArgument,
    Limit,
    BufferTooSmall,
    BadMagic,
    UnsupportedVersion,
    Corrupt,
    OutOfMemory,
}

impl Error {
    pub const fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Ok => "ok",
            Self::InvalidArgument => "invalid_argument",
            Self::Limit => "limit",
            Self::BufferTooSmall => "buffer_too_small",
            Self::BadMagic => "bad_magic",
            Self::UnsupportedVersion => "unsupported_version",
            Self::Corrupt => "corrupt",
            Self::OutOfMemory => "out_of_memory",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct BundleFailure {
    pub error: Error,
    pub encoded_size: usize,
    pub error_offset: usize,
}

impl BundleFailure {
    const fn new(error: Error, encoded_size: usize, error_offset: usize) -> Self {
        Self { error, encoded_size, error_offset }
    }
}

pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, BundleFailure>;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Asset<'a> {
    pub name: &'a [u8],
    pub media_type: &'a [u8],
    pub data: &'a [u8],
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct BundleInput<'a> {
    pub manifest_json: &'a [u8],
    pub scene_svg: &'a [u8],
    pub timeline_json: &'a [u8],
    pub assets: &'a [Asset<'a>],
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct BundleView<'a> {
    pub version: u32,
    pub manifest_json: &'a [u8],
    pub scene_svg: &'a [u8],
    pub timeline_json: &'a [u8],
    pub encoded: &'a [u8],
    pub asset_count: usize,
    asset_start: usize,
}

impl<'a> BundleView<'a> {
    /// Returns an asset whose byte slices remain tied to the encoded input.
    pub fn asset_at(&self, index: usize) -> Option<Asset<'a>> {
        if index >= self.asset_count { return None; }
        let mut offset = self.asset_start;
        for _ in 0..index {
            let header = self.encoded.get(offset..offset.checked_add(ASSET_HEADER_BYTES)?)?;
            let name_len = usize::from(read_u16(header, 0)?);
            let media_len = usize::from(read_u16(header, 2)?);
            let data_len = usize::try_from(read_u64(header, 8)?).ok()?;
            offset = offset.checked_add(ASSET_HEADER_BYTES)?
                .checked_add(name_len)?.checked_add(media_len)?.checked_add(data_len)?;
        }
        read_asset(self.encoded, &mut offset).ok()
    }
}

fn failure(error: Error) -> BundleFailure { BundleFailure::new(error, 0, 0) }

fn checked_add(total: usize, amount: usize) -> Option<usize> { total.checked_add(amount) }

fn valid_name(name: &[u8]) -> bool {
    !name.is_empty() && name.len() <= MAX_ASSET_NAME_BYTES && name != b"." && name != b".."
        && name.iter().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(*byte, b'.' | b'_' | b'-'))
}

fn valid_media_type(media: &[u8]) -> bool {
    if !(3..=MAX_MEDIA_TYPE_BYTES).contains(&media.len()) { return false; }
    let mut slash = None;
    for (index, byte) in media.iter().copied().enumerate() {
        if byte == b'/' {
            if slash.is_some() || index == 0 || index + 1 == media.len() { return false; }
            slash = Some(index);
        } else if !(0x21..=0x7e).contains(&byte) { return false; }
    }
    slash.is_some()
}

fn crc32_update(mut crc: u32, bytes: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    for byte in bytes {
        crc ^= u32::from(*byte);
        for _ in 0..8 {
            let mask = 0u32.wrapping_sub(crc & 1);
            crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xedb8_8320 & mask);
        }
    }
    crc
}

fn crc32(bytes: &[u8]) -> u32 { !crc32_update(u32::MAX, bytes) }

fn asset_crc32(asset: Asset<'_>) -> u32 {
    let crc = crc32_update(u32::MAX, asset.name);
    let crc = crc32_update(crc, asset.media_type);
    !crc32_update(crc, asset.data)
}

fn validate_input(input: &BundleInput<'_>) -> Result<usize> {
    if input.manifest_json.is_empty() || input.scene_svg.is_empty()
        || input.manifest_json.len() > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES
        || input.scene_svg.len() > MAX_SCENE_BYTES
        || input.timeline_json.len() > MAX_TIMELINE_BYTES
        || input.assets.len() > MAX_ASSET_COUNT
    { return Err(failure(Error::Limit)); }

    let mut total = HEADER_BYTES;
    for length in [input.manifest_json.len(), input.scene_svg.len(), input.timeline_json.len()] {
        total = checked_add(total, length).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Limit))?;
    }
    let mut asset_total = 0usize;
    for (index, asset) in input.assets.iter().enumerate() {
        if !valid_name(asset.name) || !valid_media_type(asset.media_type) {
            return Err(failure(Error::InvalidArgument));
        }
        if asset.data.len() > MAX_ASSET_BYTES {
            return Err(failure(Error::Limit));
        }
        asset_total = checked_add(asset_total, asset.data.len()).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Limit))?;
        if asset_total > MAX_ASSET_TOTAL_BYTES { return Err(failure(Error::Limit)); }
        if input.assets[..index].iter().any(|prior| prior.name == asset.name) {
            return Err(failure(Error::InvalidArgument));
        }
        let record = ASSET_HEADER_BYTES.checked_add(asset.name.len())
            .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(asset.media_type.len()))
            .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(asset.data.len()))
            .ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Limit))?;
        total = checked_add(total, record).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Limit))?;
    }
    if total > MAX_BYTES { return Err(failure(Error::Limit)); }
    Ok(total)
}

/// Computes the exact encoded length after applying all v1 input constraints.
pub fn encoded_size(input: &BundleInput<'_>) -> Result<usize> { validate_input(input) }

/// Encodes into caller storage. Validation completes before any bytes are written.
pub fn encode_into(input: &BundleInput<'_>, output: &mut [u8]) -> Result<usize> {
    let size = validate_input(input)?;
    if output.len() < size {
        return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::BufferTooSmall, size, 0));
    }
    output[..8].copy_from_slice(MAGIC);
    put_u32(output, 8, VERSION);
    put_u32(output, 12, HEADER_BYTES as u32);
    put_u32(output, 16, input.manifest_json.len() as u32);
    put_u32(output, 20, input.assets.len() as u32);
    put_u64(output, 24, input.scene_svg.len() as u64);
    put_u64(output, 32, input.timeline_json.len() as u64);
    put_u32(output, 40, crc32(input.manifest_json));
    put_u32(output, 44, crc32(input.scene_svg));
    put_u32(output, 48, crc32(input.timeline_json));
    put_u32(output, 52, 0);

    let mut offset = HEADER_BYTES;
    for bytes in [input.manifest_json, input.scene_svg, input.timeline_json] {
        output[offset..offset + bytes.len()].copy_from_slice(bytes);
        offset += bytes.len();
    }
    for asset in input.assets {
        put_u16(output, offset, asset.name.len() as u16);
        put_u16(output, offset + 2, asset.media_type.len() as u16);
        put_u32(output, offset + 4, asset_crc32(*asset));
        put_u64(output, offset + 8, asset.data.len() as u64);
        offset += ASSET_HEADER_BYTES;
        for bytes in [asset.name, asset.media_type, asset.data] {
            output[offset..offset + bytes.len()].copy_from_slice(bytes);
            offset += bytes.len();
        }
    }
    Ok(offset)
}

/// Produces an owned bundle, reporting allocator failure instead of panicking.
pub fn encode(input: &BundleInput<'_>) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let size = validate_input(input)?;
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    bytes.try_reserve_exact(size).map_err(|_: TryReserveError| failure(Error::OutOfMemory))?;
    bytes.resize(size, 0);
    encode_into(input, &mut bytes)?;
    Ok(bytes)
}

fn read_u16(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Option<u16> {
    Some(u16::from_le_bytes(bytes.get(offset..offset.checked_add(2)?)?.try_into().ok()?))
}
fn read_u32(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Option<u32> {
    Some(u32::from_le_bytes(bytes.get(offset..offset.checked_add(4)?)?.try_into().ok()?))
}
fn read_u64(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Option<u64> {
    Some(u64::from_le_bytes(bytes.get(offset..offset.checked_add(8)?)?.try_into().ok()?))
}
fn put_u16(bytes: &mut [u8], offset: usize, value: u16) {
    bytes[offset..offset + 2].copy_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
}
fn put_u32(bytes: &mut [u8], offset: usize, value: u32) {
    bytes[offset..offset + 4].copy_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
}
fn put_u64(bytes: &mut [u8], offset: usize, value: u64) {
    bytes[offset..offset + 8].copy_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
}

fn read_asset<'a>(encoded: &'a [u8], offset: &mut usize) -> Result<Asset<'a>> {
    let header_end = offset.checked_add(ASSET_HEADER_BYTES).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    let header = encoded.get(*offset..header_end).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    let name_len = usize::from(read_u16(header, 0).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?);
    let media_len = usize::from(read_u16(header, 2).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?);
    let expected_crc = read_u32(header, 4).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    let data_len64 = read_u64(header, 8).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    if data_len64 > usize::MAX as u64 {
        return Err(failure(Error::Limit));
    }
    let data_len = data_len64 as usize;
    *offset = header_end;
    let name_end = offset.checked_add(name_len).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    let name = encoded.get(*offset..name_end).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    *offset = name_end;
    let media_end = offset.checked_add(media_len).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    let media_type = encoded.get(*offset..media_end).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    *offset = media_end;
    let end = offset.checked_add(data_len).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;

}

fn preflight_asset_records(encoded: &[u8], mut offset: usize, count: usize) -> Result<()> {
    let mut total_data = 0usize;
    for _ in 0..count {
        let header_end = offset.checked_add(ASSET_HEADER_BYTES)
            .ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset))?;
        let header = encoded.get(offset..header_end)
            .ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset))?;
        let name_len = usize::from(read_u16(header, 0).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?);
        let media_len = usize::from(read_u16(header, 2).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?);
        let data_len64 = read_u64(header, 8).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
        if data_len64 > usize::MAX as u64 || data_len64 > MAX_ASSET_BYTES as u64 {
            return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::Limit, 0, offset + 8));
        }
        total_data = total_data.checked_add(data_len64 as usize)
            .ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Limit, 0, offset + 8))?;
        if total_data > MAX_ASSET_TOTAL_BYTES {
            return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::Limit, 0, offset + 8));
        }
        let record_len = ASSET_HEADER_BYTES.checked_add(name_len)
            .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(media_len))
            .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(data_len64 as usize))
            .ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset))?;
        let end = offset.checked_add(record_len)
            .ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset))?;
        let name = encoded.get(header_end..header_end.checked_add(name_len)
            .ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset))?)
            .ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset))?;
        let media_start = header_end + name_len;
        let media = encoded.get(media_start..media_start.checked_add(media_len)
            .ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset))?)
            .ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset))?;
        if end > encoded.len() { return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset)); }
        if !valid_name(name) || !valid_media_type(media) {
            return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, header_end));
        }
        offset = end;
    }
    if offset != encoded.len() { return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset)); }
    Ok(())
}

/// Validates a complete v1 bundle and returns a view borrowing its input bytes.
pub fn decode(encoded: &[u8]) -> Result<BundleView<'_>> {
    if encoded.len() < HEADER_BYTES || encoded.len() > MAX_BYTES {
        return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, encoded.len()));
    }
    if !has_magic(encoded) { return Err(failure(Error::BadMagic)); }
    let version = read_u32(encoded, 8).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    if version != VERSION { return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::UnsupportedVersion, 0, 8)); }
    if read_u32(encoded, 12) != Some(HEADER_BYTES as u32) || read_u32(encoded, 52) != Some(0) {
        return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, 12));
    }
    let manifest_len = read_u32(encoded, 16).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))? as usize;
    let asset_count = read_u32(encoded, 20).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))? as usize;
    let scene_len64 = read_u64(encoded, 24).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    let timeline_len64 = read_u64(encoded, 32).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    if manifest_len > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES || scene_len64 == 0 || scene_len64 > MAX_SCENE_BYTES as u64
        || timeline_len64 > MAX_TIMELINE_BYTES as u64 || asset_count > MAX_ASSET_COUNT
    { return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::Limit, 0, 16)); }
    let scene_len = scene_len64 as usize;
    let timeline_len = timeline_len64 as usize;
    let manifest_start = HEADER_BYTES;
    let scene_start = manifest_start.checked_add(manifest_len).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    let timeline_start = scene_start.checked_add(scene_len).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    let asset_start = timeline_start.checked_add(timeline_len).ok_or_else(|| failure(Error::Corrupt))?;
    let manifest_json = encoded.get(manifest_start..scene_start).ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, scene_start))?;
    let scene_svg = encoded.get(scene_start..timeline_start).ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, timeline_start))?;
    let timeline_json = encoded.get(timeline_start..asset_start).ok_or_else(|| BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, asset_start))?;
    if manifest_len == 0 || crc32(manifest_json) != read_u32(encoded, 40).unwrap_or_default()
        || crc32(scene_svg) != read_u32(encoded, 44).unwrap_or_default()
        || crc32(timeline_json) != read_u32(encoded, 48).unwrap_or_default()
    { return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, HEADER_BYTES)); }

    preflight_asset_records(encoded, asset_start, asset_count)?;
    let mut offset = asset_start;
    let mut names: Vec<&[u8]> = Vec::new();
    names.try_reserve_exact(asset_count).map_err(|_| failure(Error::OutOfMemory))?;
    for _ in 0..asset_count {
        let asset = read_asset(encoded, &mut offset).map_err(|_| {
            BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset)
        })?;
        if names.iter().any(|name| *name == asset.name) {
            return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset));
        }
        names.push(asset.name);
    }
    if offset != encoded.len() { return Err(BundleFailure::new(Error::Corrupt, 0, offset)); }
    Ok(BundleView { version, manifest_json, scene_svg, timeline_json, encoded, asset_count, asset_start })
}

/// Checks the fixed eight-byte bundle signature.
pub fn has_magic(encoded: &[u8]) -> bool { encoded.starts_with(MAGIC) }
